P4 Model No Feature Engineering WR
```{r}
# --- Convert wr_full_fbs column names from underscores to dots (to match Week 1 format) ---

# Get current column names
cat("Current column names in wr_full_fbs:\n")
print(colnames(wr_full_fbs))

# Convert all underscores to dots
wr_full_fbs_dots <- wr_full_fbs

colnames(wr_full_fbs_dots) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(wr_full_fbs_dots))

# Verify the conversion
cat("\nColumn names after converting _ to .:\n")
print(colnames(wr_full_fbs_dots))

# Now use this dataset for the model
wr_data <- wr_full_fbs_dots %>%
  filter(Conference.Level == "P4", 
         Position == "WR", 
         Receiving.Snaps > 10) %>%
  mutate(Row_ID = row_number())

cat("\nNumber of WRs after filtering:", nrow(wr_data), "\n")

# --- 2. Save Identifiers ---
player_info <- wr_data %>% select(Row_ID, Name, Team, Season, All.Con)

# --- 3. Select Only Numeric Features ---
drop_cols <- c(
  "Player.Id", "Name", "Team", "Conference", "Conference.Level",
  "Position", "Season", "Games.Won", "Key.Plays", "Receiving.Snaps", 
  "Explosive.Plays", "Offensive.Snaps", "All.Con"
)

# Keep only numeric columns + handle NAs
df_numeric_base <- wr_data %>%
  select(-any_of(drop_cols)) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Attach All.Con and Row_ID
df_clean <- df_numeric_base %>%
  mutate(All.Con = wr_data$All.Con, Row_ID = wr_data$Row_ID)

# --- 4. Separate Predictors ---
df_predictors <- df_clean %>% select(-All.Con, -Row_ID)

# --- 5. Remove Zero-Variance Columns ---
zero_var_cols <- sapply(df_predictors, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
df_numeric <- df_predictors[, !zero_var_cols, drop = FALSE]

# --- 6. Drop Corrupted/Bad Correlation Columns ---
cor_matrix <- cor(df_numeric, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
bad_cols <- colnames(cor_matrix)[apply(cor_matrix, 2, function(x) any(is.na(x) | is.nan(x)))]
df_numeric <- df_numeric %>% select(-any_of(bad_cols))

# --- 7. Reattach Labels ---
df_numeric$All.Con <- df_clean$All.Con[1:nrow(df_numeric)]
df_numeric$Row_ID  <- df_clean$Row_ID[1:nrow(df_numeric)]

# --- 8. Remove Highly Correlated Features ---
cor_matrix <- cor(df_numeric %>% select(-All.Con, -Row_ID))
high_cor   <- findCorrelation(cor_matrix, cutoff = 0.7)
df_final   <- df_numeric %>% select(-all_of(names(cor_matrix)[high_cor]), All.Con, Row_ID)

# --- 9. Remove Multicollinearity via VIF ---
reduce_vif <- function(df, threshold = 5) {
  y <- df$All.Con
  ids <- df$Row_ID
  X <- df %>% select(-All.Con, -Row_ID)

  qr_decomp <- qr(as.matrix(X))
  indep_cols <- qr_decomp$pivot[1:qr_decomp$rank]
  X_clean <- X[, indep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  df_clean <- cbind(X_clean, All.Con = y, Row_ID = ids)

  repeat {
    model <- glm(All.Con ~ ., data = df_clean %>% select(-Row_ID), family = binomial)
    vifs <- vif(model)
    if (max(vifs) < threshold) break
    df_clean <- df_clean %>% select(-which.max(vifs))
  }
  return(df_clean)
}

df_final_vif <- reduce_vif(df_final)
df_final_vif <- na.omit(df_final_vif)

# --- 10. Train/Test Split ---
set.seed(42)
train_index <- createDataPartition(df_final_vif$All.Con, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data  <- df_final_vif[train_index, ]
test_data   <- df_final_vif[-train_index, ]

# --- 11. Train Random Forest Model ---
rf_model <- randomForest(as.factor(All.Con) ~ ., 
                         data = train_data %>% select(-Row_ID), 
                         ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)

# --- 12. Predict & Grade ---
pred_test_prob <- predict(rf_model, test_data, type = "prob")
test_data$Composite_Score <- pred_test_prob[, 2]

test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 13. Merge Back with Names ---
test_data_named <- test_data %>% left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID")

# --- 14. Output Top Players ---
player_grades <- test_data_named %>%
  select(Name, Team, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

print(head(player_grades, 20))

# --- 15. Visualizations ---
ggplot(test_data, aes(x = Player_Grade)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of WR Grades", x = "Grade", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(test_data, aes(x = Composite_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, fill = "darkorange", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "WR Composite Score Distribution", x = "Score", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# Feature importance
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance(rf_model)),
  Importance = importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Importance), y = Importance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Feature Importance - P4 WR Model", x = "Feature", y = "MeanDecreaseGini") +
  theme_minimal()

# --- 16. Evaluation Metrics ---
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(predict(rf_model, test_data), as.factor(test_data$All.Con))

calc_metrics <- function(cm) {
  TP <- cm$table[2, 2]
  TN <- cm$table[1, 1]
  FP <- cm$table[1, 2]
  FN <- cm$table[2, 1]

  accuracy <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
  precision <- if ((TP + FP) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FP)
  recall <- if ((TP + FN) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FN)
  specificity <- if ((TN + FP) == 0) NA else TN / (TN + FP)
  balanced_accuracy <- mean(c(recall, specificity), na.rm = TRUE)
  f1_score <- if ((precision + recall) == 0 || is.na(precision + recall)) NA else 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

  tibble(
    Accuracy = as.numeric(accuracy),
    Precision = precision,
    Recall = recall,
    Specificity = specificity,
    Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy,
    F1_Score = f1_score
  )
}

calc_metrics(conf_matrix)

# --- 17. Predict for full dataset ---
full_pred_prob <- predict(rf_model, df_final_vif %>% select(-Row_ID, -All.Con), type = "prob")
df_final_vif$Composite_Score <- full_pred_prob[, 2]

# Merge back with original player info
full_data_with_info <- df_final_vif %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID")

# Assign grades based on quantiles
full_data_with_info <- full_data_with_info %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Filter for 2024 Players ---
players_2024 <- full_data_with_info %>%
  filter(Season == 2025) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Season, Composite_Score, Player_Grade)

print(players_2024)
View(players_2024)

players_2024_stats <- full_data_with_info %>%
  filter(Season == 2025) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Player_Grade, Composite_Score, everything(), -Row_ID)

View(players_2024_stats)
print(players_2024_stats)

# Quick summary
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance(rf_model)),
  Importance = importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

importance_df$Rank <- 1:nrow(importance_df)

View(importance_df)
print(importance_df)
cat("Total features:", nrow(importance_df))
```

G5 Model No Feature Engineering WR
```{r}
# --- 0. Load Libraries ---

  "Player.College.GSIS", "Player.College.GSIS.x", "Player.College.GSIS.y",
  "Season", "Games.Won", "Key.Plays"
)

# Keep only numeric columns + handle NAs
df.numeric.base <- wr_data %>%

  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Attach All.Con
df.clean <- df.numeric.base %>%
  mutate(All.Con = wr_data$All.Con)

# --- 4. Separate Predictors ---
df.predictors <- df.clean %>% select(-All.Con)

# --- 5. Remove Zero-Variance Columns ---
zero.var.cols <- sapply(df.predictors, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
df.numeric <- df.predictors[, !zero.var.cols, drop = FALSE]

# --- 6. Drop Corrupted/Bad Correlation Columns ---
cor.matrix <- cor(df.numeric, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
bad.cols <- colnames(cor.matrix)[apply(cor.matrix, 2, function(x) any(is.na(x) | is.nan(x)))]

df.numeric$All.Con <- df.clean$All.Con[1:nrow(df.numeric)]

# --- 9. Remove Multicollinearity via VIF ---
reduce.vif <- function(df, threshold = 5) {
  y <- df$All.Con
  X <- df %>% select(-All.Con)

  qr.decomp <- qr(as.matrix(X))
  indep.cols <- qr.decomp$pivot[1:qr.decomp$rank]
  X.clean <- X[, indep.cols, drop = FALSE]
  df.clean <- cbind(X.clean, All.Con = y)

    vifs <- vif(model)
    if (max(vifs) < threshold) break
    df.clean <- df.clean %>% select(-which.max(vifs))
  }
  return(df.clean)
}

df.final.vif <- reduce.vif(df.final)
df.final.vif <- na.omit(df.final.vif)

# --- 10. Train/Test Split ---

test.data   <- df.final.vif[-train.index, ]
```

P4 Week 1
```{r}
# --- P4 Week 1 WR Grading (Complete Features with All Stats) ---

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# First filter for P4 and WRs with at least 5 targets
p4_wr_week1_2024 <- wr_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4", 
         Position == "WR", 
         Offensive.Snaps > 10)

cat("Number of WRs after filtering:", nrow(p4_wr_week1_2024), "\n")
glimpse(p4_wr_week1_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps from Summary ---
wr_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "WR") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# Join snaps to WR data
p4_wr_week1_2024 <- p4_wr_week1_2024 %>%
  left_join(wr_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Check if Offensive.Snaps was added and rename if needed
if ("Offensive.Snaps.x" %in% colnames(p4_wr_week1_2024)) {
  p4_wr_week1_2024 <- p4_wr_week1_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps.x, Offensive.Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive.Snaps.x, -Offensive.Snaps.y)
}

# If Offensive.Snaps doesn't exist, create it
if (!"Offensive.Snaps" %in% colnames(p4_wr_week1_2024)) {
  p4_wr_week1_2024$Offensive.Snaps <- NA
  cat("Created Offensive.Snaps column with NAs\n")
}

# --- WR Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (Complete WR Model) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Yards.per.Route.Run" = 66.77111000 * 2,           
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 65.67360089 * 2,          
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 45.81265201 * 2,       
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 44.66015209 * 2,  
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 41.22837688 * 2,           
  
  # --- NEXT 5 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 41.11144114 * 1.5,     
  "Contested.Catches" = 40.33903165 * 1.5,           
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.on.Receptions" = 38.88289873 * 1.5, 
  "Yards.After.Catch.per.Reception" = 37.16858155 * 1.5, 
  "Dropped.Passes" = 30.64382709 * 1.5,              
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Fumbles.x" = 7.80837522,                           
  "Fumbles.Lost.x" = 4.42420420,                      
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt" = 2.67065747,   
  "Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 1.87624561,    
  "Attempts" = 1.58504359,                            
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 0.97855367,                     
  "Fumbles_Rush" = 0.12438769,                        
  "Fumbles_Lost_Rush" = 0.03044865,                   
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                            
  "Targets" = 20,                                    
  "Receptions" = 50,                                
  "Receiving.Yards" = 150,                          
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 50,                     
  "Catchable.Targets" = 3,                          
  "Contested.Targets" = 5,                          
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 4,               
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                     
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 3,                     
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 4,        
  "Explosive.Plays" = 6,                            
  "Percentage.of.Catchable.Passes.Caught" = 3,      
  "Dropped.Catchable.Passes.Percentage" = -4,       
  "Percentage.of.Targets.per.Receiving.Snaps" = 3,  
  
  # --- RUSHING STATS (Lower weights for WRs) ---
  "Rush.Yards" = 5,                                 
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 3,                          
  "First.Down.Runs" = 2,                            
  "Explosive.Runs" = 2,                             
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 1,                     
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 1,           
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 1,         
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 1,             
  "Rush.Grade" = 2                                  
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to WR dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(p4_wr_week1_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(p4_wr_week1_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
wr_input_all <- p4_wr_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights

wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(wr_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(wr_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---

  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---

  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
```

```{r}
# --- WR Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (G5 WR Model - Using importance rankings) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Receiving.Grade" = 76.9325575 * 2,           
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 68.4832694 * 2,          
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 45.4293720 * 2,       
  "Missed.Tackles.Forced.on.Receptions" = 44.4573847 * 2,  
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 39.6455588 * 2,  
  
  # --- NEXT 5 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 36.6411137 * 1.5,     
  "Contested.Catches" = 36.4971398 * 1.5,           
  "Yards.after.Catch.per.Reception" = 34.9318158 * 1.5, 
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 33.5646486 * 1.5, 
  "Dropped.Passes" = 26.2300994 * 1.5,              
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Fumbles" = 9.5351346,                           
  "Fumbles.Lost" = 5.0396970,                      
  "Missed.Tackles.Forced.per.Attempt" = 3.8712211,   
  "Yards.Before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 3.5944342,    
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 2.1897359,                    
  "Fumbles.Rush" = 0.2622774,                        
  "Fumbles.Lost.Rush" = 0.2014455,                   
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                            
  "Targets" = 20,                                    
  "Receptions" = 50,                                
  "Receiving.Yards" = 150,                          
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 50,                     
  "Catchable.Targets" = 3,                          
  "Contested.Targets" = 5,                          
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 4,               
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                     
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 3,                     
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 4,        
  "Explosive.Plays" = 6,                            
  "Percentage.of.Catchable.Passes.Caught" = 3,      
  "Dropped.Catchable.Passes.Percentage" = -4,       
  "Percentage.of.Targets.per.Receiving.Snaps" = 3,  
  
  # --- RUSHING STATS (Lower weights for WRs) ---
  "Rush.Yards" = 5,                                 
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 3,                          
  "First.Down.Runs" = 2,                            
  "Explosive.Runs" = 2,                             
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 1,                     
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 1,           
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 1,         
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 1,             
  "Rush.Grade" = 2                                  
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}
```

```{r}
# --- G5 Week 2 WR Grading (Complete Features with All Stats) ---

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Remove UCONN, UMASS, and NOTRE DAME
wr_combined_week2_2024 <- wr_combined_week2_2024 %>%
  filter(!Team %in% c("UCONN", "UMASS", "NOTRE DAME"))

# First filter for G5 and WRs with at least 10 offensive snaps
g5_wr_week2_2024 <- wr_combined_week2_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "G5", 
         Position == "WR", 
         Offensive.Snaps > 10)

cat("Number of WRs after filtering:", nrow(g5_wr_week2_2024), "\n")
glimpse(g5_wr_week2_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps from Summary ---
wr_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week2_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "WR") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# Join snaps to WR data
g5_wr_week2_2024 <- g5_wr_week2_2024 %>%
  left_join(wr_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Check if Offensive.Snaps was added and rename if needed
if ("Offensive.Snaps.x" %in% colnames(g5_wr_week2_2024)) {
  g5_wr_week2_2024 <- g5_wr_week2_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps.x, Offensive.Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive.Snaps.x, -Offensive.Snaps.y)
}

# If Offensive.Snaps doesn't exist, create it
if (!"Offensive.Snaps" %in% colnames(g5_wr_week2_2024)) {
  g5_wr_week2_2024$Offensive.Snaps <- NA
  cat("Created Offensive.Snaps column with NAs\n")
}

# --- WR Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (G5 WR Model - Using importance rankings) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Receiving.Grade" = 76.9325575 * 2,           
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 68.4832694 * 2,          
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 45.4293720 * 2,       
  "Missed.Tackles.Forced.on.Receptions" = 44.4573847 * 2,  
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 39.6455588 * 2,  
  
  # --- NEXT 5 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 36.6411137 * 1.5,     
  "Contested.Catches" = 36.4971398 * 1.5,           
  "Yards.after.Catch.per.Reception" = 34.9318158 * 1.5, 
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 33.5646486 * 1.5, 
  "Dropped.Passes" = 26.2300994 * 1.5,              
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Fumbles" = 9.5351346,                           
  "Fumbles.Lost" = 5.0396970,                      
  "Missed.Tackles.Forced.per.Attempt" = 3.8712211,   
  "Yards.Before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 3.5944342,    
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 2.1897359,                    
  "Fumbles.Rush" = 0.2622774,                        
  "Fumbles.Lost.Rush" = 0.2014455,                   
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                            
  "Targets" = 20,                                    
  "Receptions" = 50,                                
  "Receiving.Yards" = 150,                          
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 50,                     
  "Catchable.Targets" = 3,                          
  "Contested.Targets" = 5,                          
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 4,               
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                     
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 3,                     
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 4,        
  "Explosive.Plays" = 6,                            
  "Percentage.of.Catchable.Passes.Caught" = 3,      
  "Dropped.Catchable.Passes.Percentage" = -4,       
  "Percentage.of.Targets.per.Receiving.Snaps" = 3,  
  
  # --- RUSHING STATS (Lower weights for WRs) ---
  "Rush.Yards" = 5,                                 
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 3,                          
  "First.Down.Runs" = 2,                            
  "Explosive.Runs" = 2,                             
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 1,                     
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 1,           
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 1,         
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 1,             
  "Rush.Grade" = 2                                  
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to WR dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_wr_week2_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_wr_week2_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
wr_input_all <- g5_wr_week2_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(wr_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(wr_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
wr_full_view <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
wr_eval_summary <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 WR WEEK 2 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(wr_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(wr_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 WRs ===\n")
print(head(wr_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(wr_eval_summary)
View(wr_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats (all columns)
write.csv(
  wr_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 2/G5/G5 WR Full Stats Week 2.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  wr_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 2/G5/G5 WR Week 2 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. G5 WR Full Stats Week 2.csv (ALL stats included)\n")
cat("2. G5 WR Week 2 Grade 2024.csv (Summary with Composite Score & Grade)\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total WRs evaluated:", nrow(wr_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- wr_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(wr_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
  "Targets" = 20,                                    
  "Receptions" = 50,                                
  "Receiving.Yards" = 150,                          
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 50,                     
  "Catchable.Targets" = 3,                          
  "Contested.Targets" = 5,                          
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 4,               
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                     
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 3,                     
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 4,        
  "Explosive.Plays" = 6,                            
  "Percentage.of.Catchable.Passes.Caught" = 3,      
  "Dropped.Catchable.Passes.Percentage" = -4,       
  "Percentage.of.Targets.per.Receiving.Snaps" = 3,  
  
  # --- RUSHING STATS (Lower weights for WRs) ---
  "Rush.Yards" = 5,                                 
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 3,                          
  "First.Down.Runs" = 2,                            
  "Explosive.Runs" = 2,                             
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 1,                     
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 1,           
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 1,         
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 1,             
  "Rush.Grade" = 2                                  
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to WR dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_wr_week3_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_wr_week3_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
wr_input_all <- g5_wr_week3_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(wr_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(wr_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
wr_full_view <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
wr_eval_summary <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 WR WEEK 3 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(wr_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(wr_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 WRs ===\n")
print(head(wr_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(wr_eval_summary)
View(wr_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats (all columns)
write.csv(
  wr_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 3/G5/G5 WR Full Stats Week 3.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  wr_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 3/G5/G5 WR Week 3 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. G5 WR Full Stats Week 3.csv (ALL stats included)\n")
cat("2. G5 WR Week 3 Grade 2024.csv (Summary with Composite Score & Grade)\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total WRs evaluated:", nrow(wr_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- wr_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(wr_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(wr_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(wr_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---

  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
```

```{r}
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (Complete WR Model) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Yards.per.Route.Run" = 66.77111000 * 2,           
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 65.67360089 * 2,          
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 45.81265201 * 2,       
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 44.66015209 * 2,  
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 41.22837688 * 2,           
  
  # --- NEXT 5 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 41.11144114 * 1.5,     
  "Contested.Catches" = 40.33903165 * 1.5,           
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.on.Receptions" = 38.88289873 * 1.5, 
  "Yards.After.Catch.per.Reception" = 37.16858155 * 1.5, 
  "Dropped.Passes" = 30.64382709 * 1.5,              
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Fumbles.x" = 7.80837522,

  "Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt" = 2.67065747,   
  "Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 1.87624561,    
  "Attempts" = 1.58504359,                            
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 0.97855367,                     
  "Fumbles_Rush" = 0.12438769,                        
  "Fumbles_Lost_Rush" = 0.03044865,                   
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                            
  "Targets" = 20,                                    
  "Receptions" = 50,                                
  "Receiving.Yards" = 150,                          
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 50,                     
  "Catchable.Targets" = 3,                          
  "Contested.Targets" = 5,                          
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 4,               
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                     
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 3,                     
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 4,        
  "Explosive.Plays" = 6,                            
  "Percentage.of.Catchable.Passes.Caught" = 3,      
  "Dropped.Catchable.Passes.Percentage" = -4,       
  "Percentage.of.Targets.per.Receiving.Snaps" = 3,  
  
  # --- RUSHING STATS (Lower weights for WRs) ---
  "Rush.Yards" = 5,                                 
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 3,                          
  "First.Down.Runs" = 2,                            
  "Explosive.Runs" = 2,                             
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 1,                     
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 1,           
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 1,         
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 1,             
  "Rush.Grade" = 2                                  
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}
```

```{r}
# --- P4 Week 6 WR Grading (Complete Features with All Stats) ---

# Join snaps to WR data
p4_wr_week6_2024 <- p4_wr_week6_2024 %>%
  left_join(wr_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Check if Offensive.Snaps was added and rename if needed
if ("Offensive.Snaps.x" %in% colnames(p4_wr_week6_2024)) {
  p4_wr_week6_2024 <- p4_wr_week6_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps.x, Offensive.Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive.Snaps.x, -Offensive.Snaps.y)
}

# If Offensive.Snaps doesn't exist, create it
if (!"Offensive.Snaps" %in% colnames(p4_wr_week6_2024)) {
  p4_wr_week6_2024$Offensive.Snaps <- NA
  cat("Created Offensive.Snaps column with NAs\n")
}

# --- WR Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (Complete WR Model) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Yards.per.Route.Run" = 66.77111000 * 2,           
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 65.67360089 * 2,          
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 45.81265201 * 2,       
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 44.66015209 * 2,  
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 41.22837688 * 2,           
  
  # --- NEXT 5 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 41.11144114 * 1.5,     
  "Contested.Catches" = 40.33903165 * 1.5,           
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.on.Receptions" = 38.88289873 * 1.5, 
  "Yards.After.Catch.per.Reception" = 37.16858155 * 1.5, 
  "Dropped.Passes" = 30.64382709 * 1.5,              
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Fumbles.x" = 7.80837522,                           
  "Fumbles.Lost.x" = 4.42420420,                      
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt" = 2.67065747,   
  "Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 1.87624561,    
  "Attempts" = 1.58504359,                            
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 0.97855367,                     
  "Fumbles_Rush" = 0.12438769,                        
  "Fumbles_Lost_Rush" = 0.03044865,                   
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                            
  "Targets" = 20,                                    
  "Receptions" = 50,                                
  "Receiving.Yards" = 150,                          
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 50,                     
  "Catchable.Targets" = 3,                          
  "Contested.Targets" = 5,                          
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 4,               
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                     
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 3,                     
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 4,        
  "Explosive.Plays" = 6,                            
  "Percentage.of.Catchable.Passes.Caught" = 3,      
  "Dropped.Catchable.Passes.Percentage" = -4,       
  "Percentage.of.Targets.per.Receiving.Snaps" = 3,  
  
  # --- RUSHING STATS (Lower weights for WRs) ---
  "Rush.Yards" = 5,                                 
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 3,                          
  "First.Down.Runs" = 2,                            
  "Explosive.Runs" = 2,                             
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 1,                     
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 1,           
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 1,         
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 1,             
  "Rush.Grade" = 2                                  
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to WR dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(p4_wr_week6_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(p4_wr_week6_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
wr_input_all <- p4_wr_week6_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(wr_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(wr_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
wr_full_view <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
wr_eval_summary <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== P4 WR WEEK 6 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(wr_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(wr_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 WRs ===\n")
print(head(wr_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer

View(wr_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

  wr_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 6/P4/P4 WR Full Stats Week 6.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("2. P4 WR Week 6 Grade 2024.csv (Summary with Composite Score & Grade)\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---

cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
```

```{r}
  "Contested.Targets" = 5,

  "Dropped.Catchable.Passes.Percentage" = -4,

  # --- RUSHING STATS (Lower weights for WRs) ---

  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 1,           
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 1,         
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 1,             
  "Rush.Grade" = 2
```

```{r}
# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to WR dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(p4_wr_week7_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(p4_wr_week7_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
wr_input_all <- p4_wr_week7_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(wr_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(wr_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
wr_full_view <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
wr_eval_summary <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== P4 WR WEEK 7 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(wr_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(wr_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 WRs ===\n")
print(head(wr_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(wr_eval_summary)
View(wr_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats (all columns)
write.csv(
  wr_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 7/P4/P4 WR Full Stats Week 7.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  wr_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 7/P4/P4 WR Week 7 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. P4 WR Full Stats Week 7.csv (ALL stats included)\n")
cat("2. P4 WR Week 7 Grade 2024.csv (Summary with Composite Score & Grade)\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total WRs evaluated:", nrow(wr_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- wr_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(wr_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns

  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights

wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(wr_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(wr_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
```
```{r}
}

# --- WR Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (G5 WR Model - Using importance rankings) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Receiving.Grade" = 76.9325575 * 2,           
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 68.4832694 * 2,          
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 45.4293720 * 2,       
  "Missed.Tackles.Forced.on.Receptions" = 44.4573847 * 2,  
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 39.6455588 * 2,  
  
  # --- NEXT 5 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 36.6411137 * 1.5,     
  "Contested.Catches" = 36.4971398 * 1.5,           
  "Yards.after.Catch.per.Reception" = 34.9318158 * 1.5, 
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 33.5646486 * 1.5, 
  "Dropped.Passes" = 26.2300994 * 1.5,              
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Fumbles" = 9.5351346,                           
  "Fumbles.Lost" = 5.0396970,                      
  "Missed.Tackles.Forced.per.Attempt" = 3.8712211,   
  "Yards.Before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 3.5944342,    
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 2.1897359,                    
  "Fumbles.Rush" = 0.2622774,                        
  "Fumbles.Lost.Rush" = 0.2014455,                   
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                            
  "Targets" = 20,                                    
  "Receptions" = 50,                                
  "Receiving.Yards" = 150,                          
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 50,                     
  "Catchable.Targets" = 3,                          
  "Contested.Targets" = 5,                          
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 4,               
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                     
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 3,                     
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 4,        
  "Explosive.Plays" = 6,                            
  "Percentage.of.Catchable.Passes.Caught" = 3,      
  "Dropped.Catchable.Passes.Percentage" = -4,       
  "Percentage.of.Targets.per.Receiving.Snaps" = 3,  
  
  # --- RUSHING STATS (Lower weights for WRs) ---
  "Rush.Yards" = 5,                                 
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 3,                          
  "First.Down.Runs" = 2,                            
  "Explosive.Runs" = 2,                             
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 1,                     
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 1,           
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 1,         
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 1,             
  "Rush.Grade" = 2                                  
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}
```

```{r}

# --- G5 Week 9 WR Grading (Like P4 Format) ---

# Remove UCONN, UMASS, and NOTRE DAME
wr_combined_week9_2024 <- wr_combined_week9_2024 %>%
  filter(!Team %in% c("UCONN", "UMASS", "NOTRE DAME"))

# First filter for G5 and WRs with at least 10 offensive snaps
g5_wr_week9_2024 <- wr_combined_week9_2024 %>%

         Position == "WR", 
         Offensive.Snaps > 10)

cat("Number of WRs after filtering:", nrow(g5_wr_week9_2024), "\n")
glimpse(g5_wr_week9_2024)

# --- Add Offensive Snaps from Summary ---
wr_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week9_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "WR") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# Join snaps to WR data
g5_wr_week9_2024 <- g5_wr_week9_2024 %>%
  left_join(wr_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# Check if Offensive.Snaps was added and rename if needed
if ("Offensive.Snaps.x" %in% colnames(g5_wr_week9_2024)) {
  g5_wr_week9_2024 <- g5_wr_week9_2024 %>%
    mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps.x, Offensive.Snaps.y)) %>%
    select(-Offensive.Snaps.x, -Offensive.Snaps.y)
}

# If Offensive.Snaps doesn't exist, create it
if (!"Offensive.Snaps" %in% colnames(g5_wr_week9_2024)) {
  g5_wr_week9_2024$Offensive.Snaps <- NA
  cat("Created Offensive.Snaps column with NAs\n")
}

# --- WR Weighted Grading Model (Complete Features) ---

# Clear any existing model_features object
if (exists("model_features")) {
  rm(model_features)
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (G5 WR Model - Using your importance rankings) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Receiving.Grade" = 76.9325575 * 2,           
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 68.4832694 * 2,          
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 45.4293720 * 2,       
  "Missed.Tackles.Forced.on.Receptions" = 44.4573847 * 2,  
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 39.6455588 * 2,  
  
  # --- NEXT 5 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 36.6411137 * 1.5,     
  "Contested.Catches" = 36.4971398 * 1.5,           
  "Yards.after.Catch.per.Reception" = 34.9318158 * 1.5, 
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 33.5646486 * 1.5, 
  "Dropped.Passes" = 26.2300994 * 1.5,              
  
  # --- REMAINING TOP FEATURES ---
  "Fumbles" = 9.5351346,                           
  "Fumbles.Lost" = 5.0396970,                      
  "Missed.Tackles.Forced.per.Attempt" = 3.8712211,   
  "Yards.Before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 3.5944342,    
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 2.1897359,                    
  "Fumbles.Rush" = 0.2622774,                        
  "Fumbles.Lost.Rush" = 0.2014455,                   
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                            
  "Targets" = 20,                                    
  "Receptions" = 50,                                
  "Receiving.Yards" = 150,                          
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 50,                     
  "Catchable.Targets" = 3,                          
  "Contested.Targets" = 5,                          
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 4,               
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                     
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 3,                     
  "Completion.Percentage.when.Targeted" = 4,        
  "Explosive.Plays" = 6,                            
  "Percentage.of.Catchable.Passes.Caught" = 3,      
  "Dropped.Catchable.Passes.Percentage" = -4,       
  "Percentage.of.Targets.per.Receiving.Snaps" = 3,  
  
  # --- RUSHING STATS (Lower weights for WRs) ---
  "Rush.Yards" = 5,                                 
  "Yards.per.Attempt" = 3,                          
  "First.Down.Runs" = 2,                            
  "Explosive.Runs" = 2,                             
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 1,                     
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 1,           
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 1,         
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 1,             
  "Rush.Grade" = 2                                  
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to WR dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_wr_week9_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_wr_week9_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
wr_input_all <- g5_wr_week9_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(wr_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(wr_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View ---
important_features <- names(feature_weights)

wr_full_view <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    Receiving.Yards, Receiving.Touchdowns, Targets, Receptions,
    any_of(important_features)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
wr_eval_summary <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 WR WEEK 9 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(wr_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(wr_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 WRs ===\n")
print(head(wr_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(wr_eval_summary)
View(wr_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats
write.csv(
  wr_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 9/G5/G5 WR Full Stats Week 9.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet

  wr_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 9/G5/G5 WR Week 9 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. G5 WR Full Stats Week 9.csv\n")
cat("2. G5 WR Week 9 Grade 2024.csv\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total WRs evaluated:", nrow(wr_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---

  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(wr_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                            
  "Targets" = 20,                                    
  "Receptions" = 50,

  # --- RUSHING STATS (Lower weights for WRs) ---

  "Explosive.Runs" = 2,
```

```{r}
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 1,           
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 1,         
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 1,             
  "Rush.Grade" = 2                                  
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# --- 4. Define calculate_weighted_score function ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[feature]
    
    if (!is.na(weight) && feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights[names(weights) %in% features]))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to WR dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_wr_week10_2024))

# Check for missing features
missing_features <- setdiff(model_features, colnames(g5_wr_week10_2024))
if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
wr_input_all <- g5_wr_week10_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(wr_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(wr_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
wr_full_view <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
wr_eval_summary <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---
cat("\n=== G5 WR WEEK 10 GRADES ===\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
print(head(wr_eval_summary, 20))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION ===\n")
print(table(wr_eval_summary$Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== TOP 10 WRs ===\n")
print(head(wr_eval_summary, 10))

# View in RStudio viewer
View(wr_eval_summary)
View(wr_full_view)

# --- 11. Save Files ---

# Save Full Stats (all columns)
write.csv(
  wr_full_view,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 10/G5/G5 WR Full Stats Week 10.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save Grade Sheet
write.csv(
  wr_eval_summary,
  "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Offense/Week 10/G5/G5 WR Week 10 Grade 2024.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== FILES SAVED SUCCESSFULLY ===\n")
cat("1. G5 WR Full Stats Week 10.csv (ALL stats included)\n")
cat("2. G5 WR Week 10 Grade 2024.csv (Summary with Composite Score & Grade)\n")

# --- 12. Display Summary Statistics ---
cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total WRs evaluated:", nrow(wr_eval_summary), "\n")
cat("Average Composite Score:", round(mean(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Median Composite Score:", round(median(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), 2), "\n")
cat("Highest Score:", max(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")
cat("Lowest Score:", min(wr_eval_summary$Composite_Score), "\n")

# --- 13. Grade Distribution Table ---
grade_dist <- wr_eval_summary %>%
  group_by(Player_Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = round(n() / nrow(wr_eval_summary) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Player_Grade))

cat("\n=== GRADE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ===\n")
print(grade_dist)
```

```{r}
  return(final_scores)
}

# --- 5. Apply to WR dataset ---
# Filter to existing features
existing_features <- intersect(model_features, colnames(g5_wr_week11_2024))

# Check for missing features

  cat("Note: These features are not in the dataset and will be skipped:\n")
  print(head(missing_features, 20))
}

cat("\nExisting features found:", length(existing_features), "\n")

# Process the data
wr_input_all <- g5_wr_week11_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# Replace NA values with 0 for numeric columns
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(existing_features), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

# Calculate scores with filtered weights
filtered_weights <- feature_weights[names(feature_weights) %in% existing_features]
wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(wr_input_all, existing_features, filtered_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100) ---
if (length(unique(wr_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(wr_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  wr_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
wr_input_all <- wr_input_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 8. Create Full Stats View with ALL columns ---
wr_full_view <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 9. Final Summary (Grade Sheet) ---
wr_eval_summary <- wr_input_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

# --- 10. Print and View Grades ---

)
```

```{r}
}

# --- 1. Define ALL Feature Weights (Complete WR Model) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- TOP 5 FEATURES (2X Multiplier) ---
  "Yards.per.Route.Run" = 66.77111000 * 2,           
  "Receiving.Touchdowns" = 65.67360089 * 2,          
  "Snaps.on.Press.Coverage" = 45.81265201 * 2,       
  "Passer.Rating.when.Targetted" = 44.66015209 * 2,  
  "Yards.per.Reception" = 41.22837688 * 2,           
  
  # --- NEXT 5 FEATURES (1.5X Multiplier) ---
  "Average.Depth.of.Target" = 41.11144114 * 1.5,     
  "Contested.Catches" = 40.33903165 * 1.5,           
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.on.Receptions" = 38.88289873 * 1.5,

  "Attempts" = 1.58504359,                            
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 0.97855367,                     
  "Fumbles_Rush" = 0.12438769,                        
  "Fumbles_Lost_Rush" = 0.03044865,                   
  
  # --- ORIGINAL RECEIVING STATS (High Weights) ---
  "Receiving.Snaps" = 2,                            
  "Targets" = 20,                                    
  "Receptions" = 50,                                
  "Receiving.Yards" = 150,                          
  "Receiving.First.Downs" = 50,                     
  "Catchable.Targets" = 3,                          
  "Contested.Targets" = 5,                          
  "Contested.Catches.Percentage" = 4,               
  "Slot.Target.Percentage" = 2,                     
  "Deep.Target.Percentage" = 3,
```
